Class SecondFlightBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.FlightBoard
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.SecondFlightBoard
public class SecondFlightBoard extends FlightBoard
SecondFlightBoard class represents the second flight board in the Galaxy Truckers game. It extends the FlightBoard class and provides specific functionality for the second flight board, including choosing the starting position on placement and removing ships.
